title: Fourier transform of a convolution
statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, and let $f,g:G\to\mathbb{C}$ and $\chi$ be an additive character of $G$. The Fourier coefficient at $\chi$ of the normalized convolution of $f$ and $g$ is the product of their Fourier coefficients at $\chi$.
